structure.note: Directive §4 requires the mapping direction to be verified rather than assumed from the filename. It is MID -> name, the direction we need.

HARD_STRUCTURAL_LIMIT_g_MIDS.finding: The file contains ZERO g. machine ids.
HARD_STRUCTURAL_LIMIT_g_MIDS.consequence: It cannot name ANY of the 405,357 g. MIDs in the RoG bare-MID population, no matter how complete it is for m. ids. This is a structural property of the resource, not a coverage shortfall.
HARD_STRUCTURAL_LIMIT_g_MIDS.bears_on: the ORDINARY_ENTITY_UNRESOLVED_N = 0 target in directive §13. The prior audit noted the ordinary-entity unresolved leaves are overwhelmingly g. machine ids -- late Freebase objects that plausibly never carried type.object.name. This file is silent on all of them, so it can neither confirm nor refute that.
HARD_STRUCTURAL_LIMIT_g_MIDS.forbidden_inference: Absence of a g. MID here is NOT evidence that it has no Freebase name. The file simply has no g. entries at all.

collapse_measurement.what_this_measures: How many DISTINCT Freebase MIDs share a single display name. This is the mechanism by which RoG's name projection merged identities, measured directly on a MID->name table rather than extrapolated from a sample of RoG surfaces.

comparison_to_prior_extrapolation.prior: 1,782 of 34,972 sampled RoG surfaces (5.10%) mapped to >=2 distinct MIDs; max collision 46; extrapolated to 10^4-10^5 merged identities
comparison_to_prior_extrapolation.measured_here: 36,944 of 462,455 names (7.99%) carry >=2 MIDs; max collision 124; 97,557 identities would be lost
comparison_to_prior_extrapolation.agreement: Same order of magnitude and the same direction; measured collision rate is somewhat higher and the tail is heavier (124 vs 46).
comparison_to_prior_extrapolation.IMPORTANT_CAVEAT: This is NOT a measurement of RoG's actual collapse. RoG's own MID->name projection is unreleased, so the names in this file are not guaranteed to be the strings RoG emitted. Treat this as a direct measurement of the MECHANISM on a real Freebase name table, and as corroboration of the prior extrapolation -- not as a recount of RoG's specific merges.

coverage.why_not_yet: Measuring NAME_MAPPING_PRESENT/MISSING against the RoG bare-MID population and against the honest name-resolvable band [19,566 .. 62,375] requires the persisted RoG endpoint list, which arrives with V1 §2 (nodes table). The counts above are structural bounds, not the per-population measurement the pre-registration requires.

third_party_incompleteness_report.claim: an open issue on cmavro/GNN-RAG titled 'entities_names.json is incomplete'
third_party_incompleteness_report.corroboration: 560,012 entries against a 2,839,896-MID NSM vocabulary is a naive ceiling of 19.7%, and the file carries no g. ids at all. Both are consistent with the report, independently of whether the issue itself was read.
